markers.to: uebersicht → 03:I; immediate left stairs to dragon floor; bidirectional

uncertain: Corridor bends and chamber proportions are schematic. The two western approaches are retained without reconstructing their detailed turns.
Dreamscythe and Weaver patrol; markers 11 and 12 indicate approximate encounter areas after Jammal’an dies.
Q10, Q11 and the four unnumbered brazier symbols are approximate placements within the documented chambers.
The central hole is not a floor connection on this map; no unverified landing or survival path is shown.
notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
Jammal’an and Ogom share an encounter; Ogom is usually killed first despite adjacent route numbers.
Dreamscythe and Weaver appear after Jammal’an. Hazzas and Morphaz guard the southern approach to Eranikus.
Avatar of Hakkar is an optional event; numbered last here, but it can be scheduled separately.
The four small circles in the western chamber represent ritual braziers. Event instructions belong in the JSON, not the image.
Class quests with drops from marked bosses use those same locations; no extra fixed drop spots are invented.
The pre-instance rares Zekkis, Kazkaz the Unholy and Veyzhak the Cannibal are outside these sheets.
